data.long_meaning: The name Reetesh is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Ritam' which means 'path'. The suffix 'esh' is added to indicate 'belonging to' or 'related to'. So, the name Reetesh can be interpreted as 'the one who belongs to or follows the path of the Sun'. The name Reetesh carries the meaning “Path of the Sun” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Reetesh usually hope their child will grow to embody path of the sun and live with faith, good character and purpose.
